name: Montshire Museum of Science Summer Camp
description_short: A science museum day camp running weekly sessions from 9am to 3:30pm. Each week has its own theme and includes hands-on exploration, experiments, observation, games and water play.
refund_policy_summary: For 2026: cancel on or before June 1 for a full refund minus a $40 administrative fee. Cancel from June 2 up to 3 weeks before the session starts for a 50% refund minus the $40 fee. No refund less than 3 weeks before the session starts. Late pick-up costs $10 per 10 minutes, starting at 3:40.
